name: trailer-guard
description: Per-repo commit attribution policy: refuses a git commit, gh pr create/edit or git push that would carry a Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer or the Generated with Claude Code footer into a repo that forbids them (tinkerologie, esphome, home-assistant upstreams by default), with the lines to remove.

policy.title: Policy
policy.description: owner/repo-glob=none|allow pairs, first match wins. A checkout is held to none when any of its remotes (origin, upstream) matches a none rule, since a fork's commits travel to its upstream in a PR.
